bic_trace_step.reason: The code shows the vulnerable construct clearly. In mana_gd_setup() at line 1502-1504, when destroying the workqueue on error path: 'destroy_workqueue(gc->service_wq)' is called but gc->service_wq is NOT set to NULL afterwards. This matches the vulnerability root cause exactly - the dangling pointer issue. Additionally, in mana_gd_cleanup() at line 1519-1520, 'destroy_workqueue(gc->service_wq)' is called without any NULL check. If mana_gd_setup() fails after allocating the workqueue and cleans up via free_workqueue label, then mana_gd_cleanup() would be called later and attempt to destroy the same workqueue again (double-free). The fix would require adding 'gc->service_wq = NULL;' after each destroy_workqueue() call, which is absent here.
